title: Veterans in Buddy's band: Porcino, Pepper and Menza
summary: He sat by Art Pepper, learned from Menza, and Al Porcino gave him Parker tapes and swam nude at the Playboy Club.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Going back to Buddy for a minute, of course it was mostly young guys but there was some older veterans in that band like Al Porcino.
Yeah, Al came on just after I joined. He came on in January of ’68.
Were those guys, did they teach you anything?

Yeah I mean Al Porcino and Art Pepper came on right at the same time, right? So I sat next to Art Pepper for almost a year on Buddy’s band, and Menza came on around the same time too. See when Jay Corre left in Vegas in ’68 I took the tenor chair for about a month and then Don Menza came on the lead chair and I went back to the fourth chair, which was good for me because I got a chance to kind of hang out with Art Pepper and hang out with Don, who taught me a lot. Menza taught me a lot. I mean he was like a father to me, he taught me all kinds of — still to this day we talk almost every week. And so yeah, I’d hang out with these guys, Art Pepper was great. Al was really interesting, and he had given me a whole bunch of Charlie Parker tapes. I used to drive him around. I had a Volkswagen that I rented and I would take him to places that he had to go. And he gave me a bunch of Charlie Parker reel to reel tapes that he had done when he was on Woody’s band and he had played the Apollo Theater and he took his reel to reel tape recorder and held it up backstage next to the speaker back there, and he taped all of these Bird shows and then he gave them to me and I put them on cassette. I still have them downstairs. They’re all out on CD now but, yeah Al would give me stuff. And of course a lot of stories about all those, the older guys.
Yeah. I heard a story, something about the Playboy Club with Buddy Rich and Al?

Yeah downstairs in Hugh Hefner’s, he had a game room downstairs in the bar with a big glass window that went into the swimming pool. And Al Porcino swam by with nothing on, in the nude, by the window of the pool. Yeah.
